title: Moraine Lake Sunrise Experience
includes: Pick up from the public bus parking located behind the Mount Royal Hotel if no pick up selected
Small group size (up to 24 guests per guide)
Hotel pick up and drop off is available on request, please contact us directly.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Guided sunrise access to Moraine Lake with hotel pickup, fewer crowds, and views. 

Our tour offers a stress-free and unforgettable way to experience Moraine Lake at sunrise. With personal vehicle access restricted, we provide convenient hotel pickup and drop-off in Banff and comfortable transportation directly to the lake. Arriving well before sunrise allows you time to choose the perfect viewpoint and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere as the Valley of the Ten Peaks begins to glow. 

Included warm tea, a fresh pastry, and cozy blankets add comfort to the experience, while a knowledgeable local guide shares stories, history, and photography tips, making this a truly special Banff bucket list moment.
